correctness.rationale: Exact symbolic factorization gives  \(G(x)=-x^2(P+Qx)/[(u+knx)(1+qx)]\) with \(P,Q>0\); logistic comparison gives global boundedness and predator lower limit \(a\); Poincaré–Bendixson plus index excludes interior cycles; the only complete bounded omega-limit orbit on \(x=0\) with \(y\ge a\) is \(E=(0,a)\). The center-manifold coefficient is \(-P/u<0\) and the invariant strong-stable branch is exactly \(x=0\), hence all strictly positive solutions obey \(t x(t)^2\to u/(2P)\). The actual checker confirms the algebra and a strictly positive rational witness. Boundary initials, positive delays and perturbations off both exact conditions are excluded.

value.rationale: The equalities are not arbitrary constraints: they enforce zero value and first derivative of the invasion growth at the predator-only boundary. At precisely this missing double-critical point, the conclusion is a complete all-positive-state global basin and a universal nonhyperbolic relaxation exponent with explicit amplitude, complementing the motivating strict-sign local analysis. This characterizes biologically meaningful extinction timing without pretending to treat any positive delay.
